depiction.primary_object: three stacked horizontal bars representing a list or menu
modifiers: circular badge at top right containing a checkmark
depiction.composition: flat stack of bars on bottom-left with large circular badge overlapping the top right

readings.meaning: checklist, to-do list, or verified list
completed queue, playlist, or batch of items
database or server stack health check

ambiguity: At small sizes, the three horizontal bars can look like a stack of coins, pancakes, or server blades rather than text lines or a list.

modifier_semantics.meaning: completed, verified, approved, or checked off

task_intents: complete a preparation or packing checklist
verify items on an inventory list
review and approve a task queue

reasoning: The icon depicts three horizontal lines representing a list or queue with a prominent checkmark badge indicating completion or verification. It fits tasks centered on checklists, inventories, and backlog sign-offs, though in a task manager it is somewhat meta and shares visual space with clipboard-style checklist icons.
